# ui::ImageSource

Header: `winui/render/ImageSource.hpp`.

What an [Image](../controls/image.md#uiimage) element shows: a still [Bitmap](bitmap.md), an [AnimatedImage](animated-image.md) or an [SvgImage](svg-image.md), held by value.

Converts implicitly from each of the three, so `.source = photo` works whichever `photo` is. Copying an ImageSource copies a still picture's pixels, so build one once and move it in. [load()](#load) instead decodes a file on a background thread: the source is empty while it loads, and an [Image](../controls/image.md#uiimage) showing it lays itself out again and raises on_image_opened (or on_image_failed) once the decode is done.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Bitmap       photo = ui::Bitmap::read("photo.jpg", {.max_width = 800});
ui::ImageSource gif   = ui::AnimatedImage::read("spinner.gif");
ui::ImageSource logo  = ui::SvgImage::read("logo.svg");

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::Image{.source = std::move(photo), .stretch = ui::Stretch::UniformToFill, .height = 200},
        ui::Image{.source = gif},
        ui::Image{.source = logo, .width = 64, .height = 64},
    },
});
```

## ImageSource

```cpp
ImageSource() = default
```

An empty source; an [Image](../controls/image.md#uiimage) showing it draws nothing.

## ImageSource

```cpp
ImageSource(Bitmap image)
```

A still picture.

## ImageSource

```cpp
ImageSource(AnimatedImage image)
```

An animated picture, which the [Image](../controls/image.md#uiimage) element plays.

## ImageSource

```cpp

```

## load_state

```cpp
ImageLoadState load_state() const
```

Loading or Failed for a [load()](#load) still decoding or one that failed; Loaded otherwise.

## load_error

```cpp
std::string load_error() const
```

Why a [load()](#load) failed; empty unless [load_state()](#load_state) is Failed.

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const
```

True when there is no content, or the content itself is empty (zero-size or no frames).

## natural_size

```cpp
Size natural_size() const
```

The content's own size in DIPs, one pixel to a DIP for a bitmap: what an [Image](../controls/image.md#uiimage) with [Stretch](namespace-ui.md#stretch) None draws at.

## load

```cpp
static ImageSource load(std::filesystem::path path)
```

Decodes the picture at `path` on a background thread, choosing the decoder by its extension: an SVG document for [`.svg`](#svg), an animated image for `.gif`, a still picture otherwise. Copies share the decode.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Image{.source = ui::ImageSource::load("photos/cliff.jpg"), .stretch = ui::Stretch::UniformToFill}
```
